topic: Partners & teamwork + another / the other / others（夥伴與合作＋another / the other / others 陷阱）

shadow.speaker: Hsiao Bi-khim 蕭美琴（時任駐美代表；ALEC 第 48 屆年會演講，美國猶他州，2021 年 7 月）

chunks.text: So this is a bilateral partnership that reinforces our strengths, and we help each other.
Let me give you another concrete example.
We just heard from the Senate President from the state of Arizona.
Now Taiwan's semiconductor company, TSMC, is now working on a 12 billion dollar investment in Arizona to produce semiconductor chips.

phrases.zh: 再給你一個具體的例子

respond.prompt_en: Who is a good partner for you (a friend, a classmate, a family member), and how do you help each other? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 誰是你的好夥伴（朋友、同學或家人）？你們怎麼互相幫忙？用一句英文回答。（可以用 …and I help each other with… 或 One example is…）

vocab.example: Our school has a partnership with a school in Japan.
vocab.note: partner（夥伴）＋ -ship（關係）。同家族：friendship、relationship。蕭美琴原句：a bilateral partnership（雙邊合作關係）。

vocab.example: Doing a short quiz every day reinforces what you learn in class.
vocab.note: re-（再）＋ inforce ≈ 再使變強。比 make…stronger 更正式，FCE 寫作很好用。蕭美琴原句：reinforces our strengths。

vocab.example: Can you give me a concrete example instead of just saying "It's good"?
vocab.note: 一字多義：當名詞是「混凝土」。反義 abstract（抽象的）。a concrete example＝具體的例子。

vocab.example: Learning English is a great investment in your future.
vocab.note: invest in + N（投資在…）；make an investment in。介系詞固定用 in！

vocab.example: This factory produces chips for cars and phones.
vocab.note: 一字多義＋重音陷阱：動詞 pro-DUCE（生產）、名詞 PRO-duce（農產品，不可數）。同家族：product（產品）、production（生產）。

grammar.title: another / the other / others / the others
grammar.explain:
會考最愛考「另一個／其他的」：先數一數總共有幾個、還剩幾個！
① another＋單數：「（不特定的）另一個」，還有很多可以選。例：Show me another one.
② the other：兩個裡的「另一個」，或一群裡「剩下的唯一一個」。one…, the other…
③ others＝other＋複數名詞：「（不特定的）其他一些」，不是全部。some…, others…
④ the others：「剩下的全部」。
⑤ other 是形容詞，後面一定要接名詞：other kinds、other students；不能單獨當主詞。
🔑 判斷法：剩下的是「全部」→ 加 the；只是「其中一些／隨便一個」→ 不加 the。
⚠️ 陷阱：114 會考「三個女兒，兩個讀高中，___ 讀小學」→ 剩一個 → the other，不是 another！
⭐ B2 加分：each other＝互相（蕭美琴原句 we help each other）；another two weeks＝再兩個星期（把兩週當一個整體）。
examples: Let me give you another concrete example. —— 蕭美琴原句：例子還有很多，再舉「另一個」→ another
I have two cousins. One lives in Tainan, and the other lives in Taipei. —— 只有兩個，剩下一個 → the other
Some students like math; others prefer English. —— 不特定的「其他一些人」→ others
Five of my classmates walk to school. The others take the bus. —— 剩下的全部 → the others

practice.question: I have three pens. One is red, one is blue, and ___ is black.
practice.explanation: 三支筆說了兩支，剩下「最後一支」→ the other。another 表示還有很多可以選，others 是複數，other 後面要接名詞。

uoe.passage: Last month our class started a project with a school in Japan. The two classes helped ___1___ a lot. One class collected data about rainfall, and ___2___ built a model of a small city. Our teacher said the project was a real ___3___ because both sides gave and got something. She also asked us to give one ___4___ example of what we learned, not just say "It was fun!"

gaps.explanation: 兩個班「互相」幫忙 → each other。another 是「另一個」，the others 是「剩下的全部」。
只有兩個班，說了 One class，剩下那一個 → the other（114 會考考點）。
雙方都有付出、也有收穫 → partnership（合作關係）。exception＝例外（10/23 學過的字）。
老師要「具體的」例子，不要只說好玩 → concrete。previous＝先前的、precious＝珍貴的，長得像別選錯！

quiz.question: Mr. and Mrs. Wu have three daughters. Two are in high school, and ___ is in elementary school.
quiz.explanation: 三個女兒說了兩個，剩下「最後一個」→ the other。the one 後面通常要接說明（the one who…），the next 是「下一個」。

quiz.question: I don't like any one of these three watches. Could you show me ___ one?
quiz.explanation: 這三支都不喜歡 → 要看「不在這三支裡的另一支」→ another one。the others 是複數、指剩下的全部；either 用在「兩者之一」。
quiz.source: 104會考#7（題幹前半句依原題，問句補完整）

quiz.question: There are 30 students in my class. Five of them walk to school, and ___ all take the bus.
quiz.explanation: 「剩下的 25 人全部」→ the others。others 只是「其他一些人」，不是全部；the other／another 是單數。

quiz.question: Don't just say your plan is good. Give me a ___ example so I can understand it.
quiz.explanation: a concrete example＝一個具體的例子。

quiz.question: The two companies formed a ___ to build a new factory in Arizona.
quiz.explanation: 兩家公司「合作」→ form a partnership（建立合作關係）。

quiz.question: In the clip, Hsiao Bi-khim says, "we help each other." What does she mean?
options: Taiwan helps the US, but the US doesn't help Taiwan.
Taiwan and the US both help one another.
One company helps all the other companies.
quiz.explanation: each other＝互相 → 台灣和美國「彼此」幫忙。one another 和 each other 意思一樣。

dialog.greet: Hi Roby! 我是蔡老師 😊 今天的主題是「夥伴與合作」，還有會考很愛考的 another / the other / others。Ready?
dialog.present: 先跟著蕭美琴的原聲唸一遍，再學 5 個單字和一個小陷阱：先數數看「還剩幾個」！Let's go!
correct: Nice job, Roby! 你有先數剩幾個 😎
Spot on! 這題很多人掉進陷阱，你沒有！
wrong: Not quite. 沒關係，再數一次總共有幾個 💪
Almost! 想想：剩下的是「全部」還是「其中一些」？
Oops! 錯了也是在學習，再試一次～
dialog.hint: 小提示：剩一個 → the other；剩下全部 → the others；隨便再一個 → another。
dialog.submit: Ready to check? 送出前再檢查一次喔！
dialog.done: Well done, Roby! 今天的 another / the other 你都搞定了 🎉 See you tomorrow!
